propositions: The review-bot receiver logs webhook and rerun tokens in plaintext within the query string on every access-log line, exposing the shared GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN credential to journald and any component that reads it.
The same credential is used for both Gerrit authentication and webhook verification, creating a fail-open exposure where the secret transits any log-grepping workflow without error or alarm.

The token moved from query string to X-Rebar-Token HTTP header and a TokenRedactingFilter was installed as a backstop to prevent credential leakage in all log records while preserving route and status visibility.

The operator must rotate the previously-logged GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN and verify the rotation before or after the code fix merges, since the old token cannot be treated as unexposed until rotation is complete and attested.
